name: tr-currency-currencies
title: Currencies with Turkish names
description: ISO 4217 currency codes with Turkish and English names, the symbols used in Turkish, numeric code and minor units, covering every current code and every code accepted in Turkish e-invoices (UBL-TR). Intended for currency pick lists, price formatting and e-invoicing in Turkish-language applications.

licenses.name: Unicode-3.0
licenses.title: Unicode License v3 (names and symbols from Unicode CLDR)

sources.title: Unicode CLDR 49, cldr-numbers-full, currencies in tr and en: names and symbols (Unicode License v3)
ISO 4217 List One and List Three (see world-currencies): codes, numeric codes, minor units, status
GİB e-Fatura Paketi, UBL-TR CurrencyCodeList (see e-invoicing-tr-currency-codes): e_invoice_accepted

fields.name: code
fields.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code. References code in world-currencies.

fields.name: numeric_code
fields.description: ISO 4217 numeric code, zero-padded. For withdrawn codes taken from the historic list; empty for XFU, which has none.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Currency name in Turkish, the default display name in Unicode CLDR (tr). Empty where CLDR has no Turkish name (UYW, VED, XAD).

fields.name: name_en
fields.description: Currency name in English, the default display name in Unicode CLDR (en). Empty where CLDR has none (XAD); the ISO 4217 name is in world-currencies.

fields.name: symbol
fields.description: Symbol used in Turkish text, from CLDR (tr), for example ₺, $, €. Empty where CLDR gives none, in which case the code itself is shown.

fields.name: symbol_narrow
fields.description: Narrow symbol from CLDR (tr), used where space is short and the currency is clear from context ($ for USD, AUD and CAD alike). Empty where CLDR gives none.

fields.name: minor_units
fields.description: Number of decimal places from ISO 4217 List One. Empty where ISO 4217 gives N.A. and for withdrawn codes, for which List Three gives none.

fields.name: iso_4217_status
fields.description: current when the code is in ISO 4217 List One; withdrawn when it is only in the historic list.

fields.name: e_invoice_accepted
fields.description: true when the code is in the CurrencyCodeList of the GİB UBL-TR schematron, i.e. accepted in e-Fatura and e-Arşiv Fatura.
